text_block_list.text:
(WHAM, CRUNCH,
CHOMP CHOMP, AWOOO!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The battle this autumn is truly—
a brawl under the dark of night.

—Summer training camp.
Jungle Pocket was deep in the mountains at night,
focusing her mind.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (You never know when or where some formidable rival might jump out and attack.)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(Who is the greatest rival? And when dawn breaks,
who will be the one standing there?)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (Can't even predict it. But right now, the most dangerous one seems to be—)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaaa!!

Suddenly, a voice called out
from behind Jungle Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Pokke-san, do you have a moment to talk?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
C-C-C-Cafe, don't scare me like that!
What's the big idea!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You really are the craziest of them all.
From your unpredictable antics to how you run your races.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The race...
About that...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I've decided not to run in the autumn races.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...What? Why's that?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The reason is—
choice_data_list: Could it be... an overseas expedition?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —That is correct.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"An overseas expedition?
Does that mean you're skipping the autumn races...?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ah! The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, huh.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
"The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is an international GⅠ held in France every autumn. It's the dream race that every Umamusume aspires to win."

There had long been rumors that
Manhattan Cafe might take on the challenge
of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

"With that decided, between travel preparations and
post-race fatigue, it meant she wouldn't be able
to enter several overlapping GⅠ races."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I see. Pretty boring if you ask me...
Though that does mean one less scary rival to deal with.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Don't pause every single time! It's creepy!
And after returning to the camp lodge—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
An autumn without Cafe... If that's the case,
it might not turn into as fierce a battle as we thought.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Sure, there're some pretty tough-lookin' ones.
But nobody crazy dangerous like Cafe..."
choice_data_list: No, it might be lurking somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What? Come to think of it, you were gathering
all sorts of information in your own way too, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Tell me, partner. Which one caught your intuition? The kind that's gonna push hard and aggressively?

There are several. I decided to show
Jungle Pocket the data on my computer.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha-ha! An upset for the ages!
This Satsuki Sho belongs to meee!
No Reason. An explosive Umamusume who seized the Satsuki Sho as the 15th favorite. Furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm very interested...
in this country's races♪

"Fine Motion.
She's only run one race since coming to Japan,
but she's a princess harboring outstanding running potential."

And the one I'm keeping the closest eye on
as potentially the most terrifying threat is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The Nippon Derby... slipped through our fingers.
However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Certain victory.
I will win in the autumn. —Without fail.

Symboli Kris S.
The "professional" who came from America
to fulfill her debt of gratitude to the Symboli family.

Though she narrowly finished 2nd in the Japan Derby,
she looks set to become the eye of the storm
this autumn, especially at medium distances.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I see, the ones you've got your eye on
are quite different from mine.
I didn't think there was anyone scary out there, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: So it's different in your assessment, huh?
choice_data_list: Yeah, this year is... pretty crazy.
Yeah, this year is... looking pretty intense.

text_block_list.text: The scenery we see now and the scenery of the future are entirely different. We can afford no optimism.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, got it.
Then that cafe stuff doesn't matter.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: From tomorrow on—all that's left is to polish myself to the limit!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ora ora orah! I'm not gonna lose!
I'm going all the way!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If you guys get twice as strong as you are now,
I'll get a thousand times stronger!
choice_data_list: Pokke, accelerate even harder from here!
Pokke, let's accelerate even more from here!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
ALRIGHT!
RAAAAAAAGH!!

A fiercely determined run.
Day by day, Jungle Pocket
is growing stronger and stronger by leaps and bounds.

"Just how strong will she become?
Her room for growth—seemed to have no ceiling at all."
